verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Viam serves an llms.txt at docs.viam.com (HTTP 200). Viam also publishes a dedicated agent-oriented guide, 'use-viam-from-an-agent', covering resource discovery, motion planning, and permission restrictions for agents. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of how well agents actually consume the llms.txt and agent docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: An AI agent with a shell or an SDK can operate a Viam machine the same way a person or a program can.
